description: This file contains the implementation of the OpenIdTokenStore class, which manages OpenID tokens using YesSql as the underlying storage. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and querying tokens, as well as revoking and pruning expired tokens.

classes.name: OpenIdTokenStore<TToken>
classes.description: A generic class implementing token storage operations for OpenID tokens using YesSql, including create, update, delete, find, revoke, and prune functionalities.

methods.name: CountAsync
methods.description: Counts the number of tokens in the store.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new token entry in the store.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes a token from the store.

methods.name: FindAsync
methods.description: Finds tokens based on subject, client, status, and type.

methods.description: Finds tokens by application ID.

methods.name: FindByAuthorizationIdAsync

methods.name: FindByReferenceIdAsync

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Finds a token by its ID.

methods.name: FindByPhysicalIdAsync
methods.description: Finds a token by its physical ID.

methods.name: FindBySubjectAsync
methods.description: Finds tokens by subject.
